description: Name the tmux session after the Codex thread, record which kitty window shows it (cmd+shift+o), and take back a session's bell notifications once it is answered; see ~/scripts/docs/tmux-session-rename.md, ~/scripts/docs/agent-sessions.md and ~/scripts/docs/bell-auto.md

hooks.command: if [ -n "$PASEO_TERMINAL_ID" ]; then "${PASEO_HOOK_CLI:-paseo}" hooks codex UserPromptSubmit; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if defined PASEO_TERMINAL_ID (if defined PASEO_HOOK_CLI ("%PASEO_HOOK_CLI%" hooks codex UserPromptSubmit) else (paseo hooks codex UserPromptSubmit)) else (exit /b 0)
